title: Three-Tier Commitment Map — personal OKR scratchpad
content:
PURPOSE
A compact personal framework to align day-to-day work with a single north-star for the quarter. Treat this as a working scratchpad — experiments, quick metrics, and candid retros.

OVERVIEW (Why this format)
- Problem: my weekly focus drifts between deep product work and reactive meetings.
- Solution: a three-tier commitment map that ties a quarterly Objective to monthly levers and daily rituals.
- Outcome: clearer signal for prioritization and a small set of measurable progress indicators.

NORTH-STAR OBJECTIVE (Q1 2025)
- Objective: Reduce customer-reported latency regressions in hosted-api flows and cut median tail token-cost by 18%.
- Rationale: latency and unit-cost are the two levers that unlock higher adoption for latency-sensitive PLG demos.

MONTHLY LEVERS (what I will push)
1) Feb — Model routing experiments: set up two fallback policies and measure SLO hit-rate in Canary (goal: 95% SLO for 99th percentile latency).
2) Mar — Cache surface optimizations: prefix cache for 3 high-traffic prompts, measure token reduction (goal: 12% token reduction for these flows).
3) Apr — Batching & quantization tuning for Dedicated dev cluster to reduce per-token latency variance.

DAILY RITUALS (small habits to sustain progress)
- 45min uninterrupted deep block (M/W/F) for code/bench experiments.
- End-of-day 10-min note: one finding, one blocker, one micro-action.
- Weekly Friday 30-min review: update this doc, log metrics, pick next week's lever.

KEY METRICS (baseline -> target -> current)
- 99th percentile latency (hosted-api): 520ms -> 420ms -> 495ms (2025-03-02)
- Median token-cost for top-5 flows: $0.0045/token -> $0.0037/token -> $0.0042/token
- Canary SLO hit-rate (99th): 88% -> 95% -> 91%
- Monthly active experiments running: 0 -> 3 -> 1 (cache rollout in progress)

HYPOTHESES & SMALL EXPERIMENTS
- H1: Adding a lightweight routing rule (prefer lower-latency variant for <200 token requests) will reduce median latency without significant cost increase. (Experiment: A/B on 10% traffic for two weeks)
- H2: Prefix cache on the three top intents will reduce token-cost by >=10% for those flows. (Experiment: instrument cache-hit rates + cost per session)

EXPERIMENT LOG (short)
- 2025-02-18: Canary policy v1 deployed to eu-west-1 (10% traffic). Observed 3% improvement median, no change at 99th. Logged to L-3421.
- 2025-02-27: Cache stubbed for support-ticket prompt A. Hit rate 28% in first week; token reduction ~6%.

WEEKLY CHECK-INS (selected entries)
- 2025-02-14: Kickoff. Set up Linear issue L-3421. Slack thread started (#perf-playground). Prioritized model routing and cache.
- 2025-02-21: Spent deep-block on routing rules. Discovered mismatch in sequence-length estimates from toolbar. Need small telemetry fix.
- 2025-02-28: Cache experiment shows signal but not enough. Plan: expand to second prompt and add TTL tuning.
- 2025-03-02: Quick retro below; decide to shift one deep-block from Friday -> Thursday to sync better with SRE pairing session.

RETROSPECTIVE (what worked / what didn't)
- Worked:
  * Focused deep blocks produced measurable prototype changes (routing policy + cache stub).
  * Weekly Friday review keeps momentum and forces a decision boundary.
- Didn’t work:
  * Too many ad-hoc meetings ate a deep-block last week. Need stricter calendar hygiene.
  * Instrumentation gaps (sequence-length estimation) slowed the routing experiment.

DECISIONS & TRADEOFFS
- Tradeoff: prefer small routing rules that change decision surface but not model variants to avoid output-quality regressions.
- Decision: hold off on aggressive quantization changes until canary shows stable latency reductions from routing + caching.

BLOCKERS (ask for help)
- Need one SRE pairing slot to add the telemetry patch (seq-length estimate). Requested in #perf-playground with slack ping to @Ava.
- Request permissions to spin a small Dedicated dev pool for batching experiments (estimate: 1xA10x4 for 2 weeks).

NEXT ACTIONS (priority-ordered)
- [ ] Merge telemetry patch for sequence-length estimates (owner: me; target: 2025-03-06).
- [ ] Expand cache experiment to second prompt and set TTL to 60s (owner: me; target: 2025-03-09).
- [ ] Schedule 2x2h pairing session with SRE to validate canary routing configuration (owner: Ava; target: 2025-03-07).
- [ ] Open infra request for Dedicated dev pool (owner: me; linked: L-3429).

NOTES TO SELF
- If experiment noise > 7%, add longer-run bootstrap and rely less on single-week readouts.
- Be conservative with rollout percentages for any change that touches model selection. Keep a rollback plan.

ENDPOINTS/QUICK LINKS
- Linear: L-3421 (routing), L-3429 (infra request).
- Slack: #perf-playground thread (pinned messages summary).
- Confluence draft: perf-deep-dive (private draft)

Signed — Devon
(Use as canonical weekly scratchpad. Archive to personal-notes if status -> final)
